title: Disc Station Bessatsu: I Miss You. Tanaka Katsumi
native_title: Ｄｉｓｃ Ｓｔａｔｉｏｎ別冊 ｉ ｍｉｓｓ ｙｏｕ． 田中 勝己
overview:
One! Two! Puyo SUN!

- Three protagonists to choose from by mode! 17 characters to choose from in versus!
- Use Sun Puyo to offset, then counterattack for a big comeback!
- Manzai demos and chain voices newly recorded for every character!
- Also includes the familiar Tokoton Puyo Puyo!

いち！にっ！ぷよSUN！

モードで選べる主人公3人！　対戦で選べるキャラ17人！
太陽ぷよで相殺→反撃の大逆転をねらえ！
漫才デモと連鎖ボイスは、全キャラ録りおろし！
おなじみとことんぷよぷよも収録！
